evidence.quote: Earth observation satellite – specifically for coral reef and ocean monitoring
only one satellite is required. This also just allows for simplicity
would likely be used by governmental and science agencies (e.g. CSIRO, BOM)

criteria.reasoning: Primary mission (coral reef/ocean monitoring with fluid lensing), rationale (bleaching, acidification), single spacecraft justification, and users/operators (CSIRO/BOM, Australian University/Gov) all clearly addressed with discussion and references.

evidence.quote: proposed satellite will thus use the Vega E rocket as a launch vehicle – launched from the Guiana Space Centre Spaceport
an altitude of 600km requires a mean inclination of 97.7924°
selected – the Mount Pleasant Radio Observatory

criteria.reasoning: All space segment elements covered: launch vehicle/site with justification, SSO LEO characteristics with Keplerian elements and STK 3D views, maneuvers (direct injection + EOL deorbit), ground facility with access summary and ground tracks, duration 5 years and drag-sail EOL. Supported by screenshots and calculations.

evidence.quote: fully described satellite configuration has been constructed. The initial problem of not catching coral bleaching events
A polar sun-synchronous orbit allows for consistent illumination of the oceans while maintaining a constant sun angle

criteria.reasoning: Conclusion synthesizes launch, orbit, ground station and EOL choices from evidence and notes risk (Vega E not yet built, alternative Vega C). Could be more quantitative but clearly appropriate and evidence-based.

evidence.quote: STK 3D view of orbit: 12 hours apart

criteria.reasoning: Report has logical structure and executive summary, generally readable. Figures/tables inconsistently labelled (no Figure numbers/titles), OCR artifacts. Uses Wikipedia as proper source against instruction, and references are bare URLs not properly cited, matching Adequate.

technical_issues.issue: Uses Argument of Latitude for circular orbit instead of undefined arg perigee/true anomaly; acceptable workaround but technically should set ω=0 and specify true longitude; inclination calculation correct.
Extensive use of Wikipedia timeline for launch selection against task guidance not to use Wikipedia as proper source.

overall: Solid coral-reef SSO mission benefiting Australia with well-justified launch, orbit, ground station and EOL using STK. Introduction and design comprehensive. Presentation weakened by informal figure captions and Wikipedia referencing.
